paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.
model_annotation: This bar graph illustrates the expert win rates for various large language models (LLMs) in a knowledge-grounded discussion summarization benchmark. The vertical axis represents the expert win rate as a percentage, ranging from 0% to 100%, with increments of 20%. The horizontal axis lists the names of the LLMs and the average win rate. Each LLM is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with corresponding numerical values indicating its win rate. The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The average win rate is 88.89%, and all LLMs have win rates above 82%, with GPT-4o-mini having the highest win rate at 97.56% and DeepSeek-V3 having the lowest at 82.26%.
